---
title: "Head-to-Head Franchise Comparison"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
---

Compare any professional basketball franchises side by side. Inspect full 10-point profiles including starting five lineups, full rosters, coaching staffs, franchise leaders, championships, and MVPs.

> **Statistical Note:** NBA statistics (*82-game regular season, founded 1946*) and WNBA statistics (*44-game season, founded 1997*) reflect distinct league schedules and eras. All active rosters and lineups reflect data as of **November 2026**.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(htmltools)

teams <- read_csv("data/teams.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(team_id = paste0(league, "_", row_number()))

teams_json <- toJSON(teams, dataframe = "rows", auto_unbox = TRUE)

tagList(
  tags$style(HTML("
    .compare-container {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
    }
    .picker-box {
      background: #f8fafc;
      border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 16px 20px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr));
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .picker-box label {
      display: block;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      color: #334155;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .picker-box select {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      background: #ffffff;
    }
    .grid-compare {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(350px, 1fr));
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .comp-card {
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 20px;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
    }
    .comp-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      padding-bottom: 12px;
      border-bottom: 2px solid #f1f5f9;
    }
    .comp-logo {
      width: 64px;
      height: 64px;
      object-fit: contain;
      background: #f8fafc;
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 4px;
      border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
    }
    .badge-pill {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #ffffff;
      margin-right: 5px;
    }
    .badge-nba { background: #1d428a; }
    .badge-wnba { background: #fa4616; }
    .badge-status { background: #475569; }
    .comp-fields {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .comp-field {
      background: #f8fafc;
      border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
      border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      font-size: 0.88rem;
    }
    .comp-field strong {
      display: block;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: #0f172a;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      margin-bottom: 2px;
    }
    .scroll-box {
      max-height: 100px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      font-size: 0.83rem;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }
  ")),
  HTML(paste0('
    <div class="compare-container">
      <div class="picker-box">
        <div>
          <label for="selectTeam1">Select Team 1 (NBA):</label>
          <select id="selectTeam1"></select>
        </div>
        <div>
          <label for="selectTeam2">Select Team 2 (WNBA):</label>
          <select id="selectTeam2"></select>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="grid-compare" id="comparisonTarget"></div>
    </div>

    <script>
      const ALL_TEAMS = ', teams_json, ';

      function escapeText(s) {
        return String(s || "").replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
      }

      function buildCard(t) {
        if (!t) return "";
        const badgeClass = t.league === "NBA" ? "badge-nba" : "badge-wnba";
        const fallback = `data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="64" height="64"><rect width="100%" height="100%" rx="8" fill="${t.league === "NBA" ? "%231d428a" : "%23fa4616"}"/><text x="50%" y="55%" dominant-baseline="middle" text-anchor="middle" fill="white" font-family="Arial" font-weight="bold" font-size="16">${t.league}</text></svg>`;
        const logoUrl = t.logo ? escapeText(t.logo) : fallback;

        return `
          <div class="comp-card">
            <div class="comp-header">
              <img class="comp-logo" src="${logoUrl}" alt="${escapeText(t.team)}" onerror="this.onerror=null;this.src=\'${fallback}\';" />
              <div>
                <span class="badge-pill ${badgeClass}">${escapeText(t.league)}</span>
                <span class="badge-pill badge-status">${escapeText(t.status)}</span>
                <h3 style="margin: 4px 0 2px 0; font-size: 1.25rem;">${escapeText(t.team)}</h3>
                <div style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #64748b;">${escapeText(t.city)}, ${escapeText(t.state)}</div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <p style="font-size: 0.9rem; color: #334155; margin-bottom: 14px;">${escapeText(t.description)}</p>

            <div class="comp-fields">
              <div class="comp-field">
                <strong>Conference & Division</strong>
                ${escapeText(t.conference)} Conference &mdash; ${escapeText(t.division)}
              </div>
              <div class="comp-field">
                <strong>Championships</strong>
                <b>${escapeText(t.championships)}</b> (${escapeText(t.championship_years || "None")})
              </div>
              <div class="comp-field">
                <strong>MVPs Won With Franchise</strong>
                ${escapeText(t.mvp_details || "None")}
              </div>
              <div class="comp-field">
                <strong>Current Starting Five</strong>
                ${escapeText(t.starting_five || "TBD")}
              </div>
              <div class="comp-field">
                <strong>Head Coach & Staff</strong>
                ${escapeText(t.coaching_staff || "TBD")}
              </div>
              <div class="comp-field">
                <strong>All-Time Franchise Leaders</strong>
                ${escapeText(t.all_time_leaders || "TBD")}
              </div>
              <div class="comp-field">
                <strong>Current Active Roster</strong>
                <div class="scroll-box">${escapeText(t.roster || "TBD")}</div>
              </div>
              <div class="comp-field">
                <strong>Accomplishments & History</strong>
                ${escapeText(t.accomplishments || "N/A")}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }

      function updateComparison() {
        const id1 = document.getElementById("selectTeam1").value;
        const id2 = document.getElementById("selectTeam2").value;
        const t1 = ALL_TEAMS.find(x => x.team_id === id1);
        const t2 = ALL_TEAMS.find(x => x.team_id === id2);

        document.getElementById("comparisonTarget").innerHTML = buildCard(t1) + buildCard(t2);
      }

      const sel1 = document.getElementById("selectTeam1");
      const sel2 = document.getElementById("selectTeam2");

      ALL_TEAMS.forEach(t => {
        const opt = document.createElement("option");
        opt.value = t.team_id;
        opt.textContent = `${t.team} (${t.league} - ${t.city})`;
        if (t.league === "NBA") sel1.appendChild(opt);
        else sel2.appendChild(opt);
      });

      // Default selections: Boston Celtics (NBA) & Las Vegas Aces (WNBA)
      const defNba = ALL_TEAMS.find(t => t.team.includes("Boston Celtics")) || ALL_TEAMS[0];
      const defWnba = ALL_TEAMS.find(t => t.team.includes("Las Vegas Aces")) || ALL_TEAMS.find(t => t.league === "WNBA");
      if (defNba) sel1.value = defNba.team_id;
      if (defWnba) sel2.value = defWnba.team_id;

      sel1.addEventListener("change", updateComparison);
      sel2.addEventListener("change", updateComparison);
      updateComparison();
    </script>
  '))
)
```
